project(libelfin-elf)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Generate to_string.cc from data.hh using enum-print.py
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT to_string.cc
    COMMAND bash ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate_to_string.sh ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/to_string.cc
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/data.hh ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/enum-print.py ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate_to_string.sh
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    COMMENT "Generating to_string.cc"
)

set(LIBELFIN_SOURCES
    elf.cc
    mmap_loader.cc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/to_string.cc
)

set(LIBELFIN_HEADERS
    elf++.hh
    data.hh
    common.hh
    to_hex.hh
)

add_library(libelfin STATIC ${LIBELFIN_SOURCES} ${LIBELFIN_HEADERS})

# Suppress warnings for third-party code
target_compile_options(libelfin PRIVATE -w)

target_include_directories(libelfin PUBLIC 
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include/libelfin/elf>
)

# Set output name to avoid lib prefix duplication
set_target_properties(libelfin PROPERTIES 
    OUTPUT_NAME "elfin"
    LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX
)
